title: Implement stateful business policy evaluation in replay_package
summary: Add configurable eligibility policies and threshold deductions around def main.

requirements.statement: Evaluation logic in scripts/replay_package.py must apply configurable minimum threshold rules.
acceptance_criteria: Entities strictly below the minimum threshold are rejected with an ELIGIBILITY_FAILED error.
Entities meeting or exceeding the threshold receive appropriate rule application.
Computed deductions must not result in negative final totals.

requirements.statement: Rule application must respect temporal expiration timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Expired rules are rejected with RULE_EXPIRED.

constraints: Must maintain backward compatibility with existing def main callers.
Must execute entirely in-process without remote network calls.
Execution overhead per operation must remain under 15ms.
out_of_scope: External database schema migrations or remote persistence.
Distributed lock managers or cross-process message brokers.
edge_cases: Total exactly equal to minimum requirement threshold.
Rule deduction amount exceeds entity subtotal.
assumptions: Execution environment is thread-safe for local execution.
Configuration objects are supplied in-memory or via standard environment variables.
known_limitations: Local single-process validation; cluster-level synchronisation is out of scope.
